The data collected by the tutor for this metric was varied and posed challenged 
regarding its accuracy; with some durations being recorded as “<10min” or 
others as ranges “5-10min”. To combat this, “<10min” was removed, and the 
median value was taken for ranges. 
 
Figure 57 Distractibility 
The data in Figure 57 suggest that students using the proposed application 
experienced greater distractibility levels when compared to the Bitesize 
students. When considering the lesson lengths, Bitesize lessons where longer, 
thus decreasing the frequency of when students look away. This shows a 
significant but moderate, higher distractibility level for the proposed application.  
Possible causes for increased distractibility may include the high-level questions 
increasing cognitive load, leading to more distraction opportunities, and the 
novel features of the proposed application inducing mind wandering.
